evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifying the gate by past security failures appeals to conservation — preventing recurrence, keeping the system safe.
The gate summary foregrounds a required security control — conservation of system integrity and competence in deployment craft.
Extending the gate's scope across environments appeals to conservation — uniform security coverage as the good.
